notes: The prompt self-declares as a simulator in the +1 Speed family, which normally means Simulation on tier-ladder with a Stat Grinder loop, but the answers plainly contradict that: no collecting, no unlocking, no destination, the walk and the sound are the whole game. So I overrode the declaration, led with Entertainment and kept Simulation named second — a stat ladder with training stations and purchase gates would build the one thing the author ruled out. route-guided is the Showcase shape and it is what was described: a couple of minutes of walking sequenced past a nature path and one fairy village, returning to where it started. I took it over route-circuit because there is no lap or finish being timed, so the P6 that shape carries would be validating a structure this game does not have. Deciding without a user, I treated the magic sound effects as audio dressing with no geometry to place and sized the loop as one small continuous exterior, which routes P0.
